item.title: Moving into this house as a single mum was the biggest leap I've ever taken
item.description: Moving into this house as a single mum was the biggest leap I've ever taken and I honestly never thought never thought I would be able to buy my own home, but here I am. I can honestly say this has been the best year of my life and I am so proud of everything I have done but also how much I have healed and grown as a person. Here's a look at the before and afters so far... #singlemumlife #singlemum #lifeafterdivorce #newbeginnings
